title: Any Valid Topological Ordering

constraints.edges: Directed graph with possible duplicate edges.

input_format: The first line contains n and m. Each of the next m lines contains two integers u and v, representing a directed edge from u to v.
output_format: Print a valid topological ordering of the n vertices as n integers, or IMPOSSIBLE if the graph contains a cycle.
notes: Duplicate edges should be handled gracefully.
